source: New synthetic incidents and intentionally noisy language authored before inference; no private player tickets or prior model predictions used as labels.
semantics: expected.needs_human=true is a safety requirement; false permits a verified published FAQ but does not forbid human escalation.
Only two single-topic Russian glossary questions permit automatic published FAQ replies. Rule permissions, multi-topic questions, personal incidents and non-Russian drafts require review.
Contest p0-p3 priority is separate from the support UI's now/high/normal urgency and must not silently replace it.
Only ticket is model input. expected, label_reason and challenge_tags are evaluator metadata and must never be sent to the model.
An attachment count means an attachment was supplied, not that guilt or attachment content has been verified. Merely saying a recording exists is not an attachment.
Quoted abuse, negated incidents, input channel and stated target of a complaint are material to the labels.
protocol: Check the SHA and exact ordered IDs before running algorithm-only or AI-only baselines.
Preserve baseline predictions separately before modifying the hybrid.
Keep these source labels frozen when analysing errors or improving implementation.
After errors from this set inform changes, label later scores as regression results on a studied development set, not fresh independent evaluation.
Record provider failures, abstentions, latency and actual usage; do not silently drop failed rows.
limitations: All 100 examples and labels are synthetic and provisional; none is an independent human-annotated real player case.
The dataset author knew the taxonomy and project context. The author did not run classifiers, inspect predictions or call a model while authoring these labels.
Translations, informal phrasing and noisy six-language text have not been checked by native speakers.
Unique text and scenario IDs do not prove all scenarios are semantically independent.
No reviewed draft text or citation target is provided. These labels cannot establish reply fluency or source relevance.
